grammar.title: Concession with 虽然...但是
grammar.pattern: 虽然 + fact, 但是/可是 + contrast
grammar.explanation: 虽然 (suīrán) marks a fact you accept, and 但是 (dànshì) introduces the surprising or contrasting point that follows, like "although...but". Unlike English, Chinese usually keeps both 虽然 and 但是 in the same sentence.

grammar.title: Sufficient condition with 只要...就
grammar.pattern: 只要 + minimum condition, 就 + result
grammar.explanation: 只要 (zhǐyào) means "as long as" it names the one condition that is enough to make something happen. The second clause usually adds 就 before the verb, similar to 如果...就 but with a stronger sense that this condition alone is sufficient.

sentences.zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他还是来了。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā háishi lái le.
sentences.en: Although he was busy, he still came.

sentences.zh: 虽然下雨，但是我们还是去了。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ, dànshì wǒmen háishi qù le.
sentences.en: Although it rained, we still went.

sentences.zh: 虽然这本书很难，但是很有名。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán zhè běn shū hěn nán, dànshì hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.en: Although this book is hard, it's very famous.

sentences.zh: 虽然他不是学生，但是他常常学习。
sentences.pinyin: Suīrán tā bú shì xuéshēng, dànshì tā chángcháng xuéxí.
sentences.en: Although he's not a student, he studies often.

sentences.zh: 只要你相信我，就没问题。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ xiāngxìn wǒ, jiù méi wèntí.
sentences.en: As long as you trust me, there's no problem.

sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù qù.
sentences.en: As long as I have time, I'll go.

sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ xǐhuan, jiù mǎi ba.
sentences.en: As long as you like it, buy it.

sentences.zh: 只要天气好，我们就出去。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen jiù chūqù.
sentences.en: As long as the weather's good, we'll go out.
After class, we're going to eat.
